AxisOS bootable disk image.

Download **axisos.img** below and run it with QEMU:

    qemu-system-i386 -drive file=axisos.img,format=raw -nic user,model=e1000

Four systems in one — Linux, Windows, FreeBSD and MS-DOS — with a custom
bootloader, text web browser, App Store, file explorer, editor, a retro
mouse desktop, the Shello retro shell, a Linux/FreeBSD program layer, an
archiver, an offline AI assistant and networking. See the README for details.
